the application of VFA rich acidified food waste as PSA for the integrated organic farming.

the utilization of food waste as substrate for bio-hydrogen and VFA production and the application of VFA rich outlet as phosphate solubility agent for integrated farming.

the AO from biohydrogen process could be used as a phosphate solubilizer and could be a potential candidate for the development of integrated organic farming.

the VFA rich AO can be utilized for the production of organic food and simultaneously can be used as PSA to improve the phosphate solubility for plant uptake in integrated organic farming.
